warnings: op1 direct read (house 13, Stage-2 SN-EE-M agent). LAST SHEET of the sanitary (SN) set for this house -- SN-09 of 9 per the หน้า50 index. Values in both tables match houses 03/04's equivalent hanger-spacing tables verbatim (same standard reference tables reused across this house series).

The 4 numbered หมายเหตุ items are printed without an explicit subject line tying each number to a specific requirement (e.g. which note governs 'ทุกๆชั้นของอาคาร' vs 'ทุกๆระยะ 1.0 เมตร') -- transcribed exactly as printed; read together they describe the minimum hanger/support frequency rule (at least one per pipe length, at every floor level and every joint, and never less often than every 1.0m (small pipe) or 1.2m (larger pipe) per the tables above).

Hanger/tables + detail drawing kept in one file since they are one cohesive 'hanger installation standard' sheet (schedule pattern with an attached small detail sketch), consistent with the treatment of SN-07/SN-08's grouped installation details.
